title: Frugal Orchestra: Initiative Tracking for Adaptive Batching, Caching, and Quant Profiles
creator: Priya Shah
description: Objective: deliver a tracked, measurable initiative that reduces per-token unit cost by 15% for mid-tail production workloads through coordinated adaptive batching, KV/prefix caching, and targeted quantization profiles. This ticket consolidates planning, acceptance criteria, rollout milestones, and cross-functional tasks for the 'Frugal Orchestra' initiative. Scope includes: experiment grid, canary rollout plan (hosted + dedicated), console telemetry and rollout toggles, and a playbook for safe quant profile selections. Out of scope for this ticket: hardware procurement and new model architecture changes.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end experiment matrix executed across 3 representative workloads with baseline vs optimized configs recorded
Observable SLOs: p95 latency degradation <= 10% and overall cost/unit reduction >= 15% on target workloads
Canary rollout plan documented and validated with rollback criteria and automated fallback to compatible model variants
Console dashboards updated to show token-level cost delta, batching throughput, and cache hit-rate by route
Playbook and checklist published in Confluence with required checks for quant profile safety and failure modes
